name: Cuscapi Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约，主要公告为股本削减与股份发行计划（SIS）等企业行动，以及多项诉讼和董事委员会变动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增3.1%，净利润同比增149.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, there were no announcements on business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts; the main announcements were corporate actions such as share capital reduction and a proposed share issuance scheme (SIS), along with litigation updates and changes in board committees. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 3.1% year-on-year and net profit rose 149.9% year-on-year.
